verdict.rationale: The evidence shows versioned API surfaces: the Konnect AI Gateway API is published under a /v1 path, and the gateway exposes versioned route formats such as llm/v1/chat. There is also a documented migration path from AI Gateway on Kong Gateway 3.x to the 2.x control plane via a kongctl conversion extension. No deprecation policy, support windows or sunset timelines are documented anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation policy and timelines, an API versioning/changelog policy, and independent corroboration.
